تمايزت (form VI)
# تَمَايَزْتُ (tamāyaztu) /ta.maː.jaz.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَمَايَزَ (tamāyaza)
# تَمَايَزْتَ (tamāyazta) /ta.maː.jaz.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَمَايَزَ (tamāyaza)
# تَمَايَزْتِ (tamāyazti) /ta.maː.jaz.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَمَايَزَ (tamāyaza)
# تَمَايَزَتْ (tamāyazat) /ta.maː.ja.zat/: third-person fem
